# CityMETER · Hospital

> Beds the MOPH health-facility register (HCODE) reports and health-facility records across Thailand by district (เขต/อำเภอ), with straight-line distance to rail stations (CityMETER Transit), affiliation and service level as registered, published accreditation (HA stage and dates, JCI programmes), DIT lab prices, services as recorded and a comparison set per facility. A Landometer CityMETER public demo, release 0.1.0 (2026-11-05). Research master checked to 2026-11-01, read 2026-11-05.

What one figure means:
- beds (เตียง) = Σ official_reported_beds_text, the beds HCODE reports. Not staffed beds, occupancy, demand or capacity on a given day. A reported 0 (primary care, clinics) adds 0; unknown beds are counted apart, never as 0.
- records (แห่ง) = rows of the research master the owner approved into scope: CityMETER production Hospital records (CMH-*) and HCODE register records (HCODE-*). Operation is not revalidated; not a census of unique facilities.
- points = CityMETER production's own facility points (12,516). HCODE records (mostly clinics) have no point; they count in their district and lists.
- accreditation = published evidence (HA stage, issue and expiry dates; JCI programme and effective date). Not a quality ranking or an outcome.
- lab prices = DIT published prices of six lab items and their sum, checked 2026-10-31, effective date not shown by the source; the level (ต่ำมาก…สูงมาก) ranks the sum among the 262 facilities with all six. Per facility only; never a bill, a package or the facility's price level.
- NHSO role = production's grouping of the open NHSO service-network register (mastercupuc FY2568 Q3): CUP · primary · referral-only · not found.
- distances = straight lines between reference points, not walking routes, travel times or catchments.
- districts = CityMETER production districts (codes as in https://landometer.com/v3/citymeter/{province}/D/{district}?d=hospital), matched from each record's registered district.

Snapshot (release 0.1.0; fixtures, recompute from data):
- 41,828 records, 186,453 beds reported (1,597 records with beds; 16,453 with unknown beds), 928 districts, 77 provinces.
- Bangkok: 32% of the province's beds (10,984 of 34,030) are in Ratchathewi, Bangkok Noi and Pathum Wan; 38% of their beds with a point lie within 500 m of an operating rail station, against 37% in the rest of Bangkok.
- The district with the most beds outside Bangkok: Mueang Chiang Mai (4,113). By records, Hat Yai (460) holds more than any Bangkok khet.
- 63.5% of the beds are in facilities of the Ministry of Public Health.

Deep links (https://montri-th.github.io/hospital/):
- ?metric=count — measure records instead of beds
- ?province={code} — e.g. BKK, CMI, SKA (production codes)
- ?area={district code} — e.g. 1037 (เขตราชเทวี)
- ?areas={code},{code} | ?areas=all — focus districts / every district
- ?group={regional|private|community|public_other|subdistrict|center|clinic|other} · ?size={b1…b5} · ?aff={moph|local|public|private|none}
- ?facility={record id} · ?station={CityMETER Transit station id} · ?view={areas|mix|aff} · ?search={text}

Data and method:
- [Product statement](https://montri-th.github.io/hospital/PRODUCT_STATEMENT.md): users, problem, claim boundary
- [Data and method](https://montri-th.github.io/hospital/DATA_METHOD.md): sources, measures, district matching, context joins, limits
- [Dataset](https://montri-th.github.io/hospital/data/hospitals.json): columnar rows + dictionaries + provenance (meta)
- [Developer handoff](https://montri-th.github.io/hospital/handoff/START_HERE.md)

Map reading: symbol area grows with the reported beds (a reported 0 is the smallest symbol; hollow = unknown); names near the middle of the view rank by beds and published accreditation; buildings per area are CityMETER Building V4 where it holds at least 1.15 × the OpenStreetMap buildings, else OpenStreetMap (units of CityMETER · Hotel 0.3.6); choosing a facility with a point opens a two-point perspective of a 3D building — the drawn building whose outline holds the pin, else the nearest drawn building within 300 m (800 m when nothing is drawn within 300 m), labelled “อาคารใกล้หมุด”; that is a camera choice, not a claim that the facility is in it.

Ask Google: every view links to a Google Search for the question of the view (opening hours, specialists, accepted rights and insurance, getting there). Google's answers are not CityMETER data and are never copied into it.

Do not claim from this data: occupancy, staffed beds, patient volumes, revenue, market share, quality rankings or outcomes, that a facility is open today, current prices or bills, walking time, catchments, that a facility without an accreditation chip failed accreditation, that a district without beds has no health services, or that a building height is measured (CityMETER heights are model estimates).
